summary: For every fixed local child-curvature scale c>0 there are exact-rank-three signature-(2,1) target matrices with unit physical diagonals, every physical principal pair PSD, and globally balanced positive edge signs, but every physical 2x2 submatrix has second singular value <=10/m<c. The family is nevertheless uniformly bounded after three disjoint original-coordinate bank aggregates, with ||p_Q||inf<=8sqrt(pi). Thus the r23 fixed-scale eight-coordinate packet cannot be forced from the bare spectral hypothesis; high-cardinality balanced-bank aggregation must precede local inversion.
